summary.text: White steel is a rank six immortal material counted among the earth vein essences.

claims.text: White steel is a rank six immortal material and one of the earth vein essences. From a huge piece of white steel there is often only a small bowl of white steel extract, which is a separate rank seven immortal material. Tie Qu Zhong wants a white steel extract resource point in his immortal aperture so his rank seven edge Gu can be fed without relying on temporary replacements such as dragonfish.

Fang Yuan extorts Shang clan for the production method and construction materials of the white steel extract resource point, then builds white steel bowl valley in Mini Southern Border. An earth path killer move molds about one hundred li of terrain into a circular valley ringed by mountains, isolated from outside. The sunken floor has little soil or vegetation and is covered by a large amount of steel. Once complete, the medium sized point coagulates rank seven white steel extract at the valley center, enough for him to feed rank seven edge Gu himself.

Shi Shi Cheng watches Fang Yuan shape another white steel bowl valley in Mini Southern Border: the same sunken steel-covered valley, called a mid-scale resource point and built with little effort relative to Fang Yuan’s other work. Tie Qu Zhong had wanted that construction and never started it; with the valley, edge Gu can be fed without external supply. A small portion of immortal materials extorted from Southern Border’s righteous path goes to filling aperture gaps such as this valley.

When a huge tribulation strikes the sovereign immortal aperture, Inkman City Lord Mo Tan Sang in Mini Western Desert sends four Gu Immortals out of the city to look after white steel bowl valley, rotten swamp, hibiscus trees, and other resource points. If the situation turns urgent, those Gu Immortals are to retrieve as many of the resources as possible into Inkman City’s storage.
